/**
 * The following styles get applied both on the front of your site
 * and in the editor.
 *
 * Replace them with your own styles or remove the file completely.
 */
.wp-block-create-block-new-products {
  color: black;
  padding: 2px;
}

.wp-block-rawlplug-blocks-card-block {
  --card-block-heading-color: #036;
}

.wp-block-modeco-blocks-card-block {
  --card-block-heading-color: #b80000;
}

.card-block {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.card-block > * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.card-block__wrapper {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid #e4e4e4;
  background-color: #fff;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: top center;
  background-size: cover;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 0 120% 0;
  padding-bottom: 160%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.card-block__tag {
  font-size: 1.2em;
  line-height: 21px;
  background-color: #7ab800;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  color: #fff;
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  right: 10px;
  z-index: 40;
}
.card-block h3.card-block__title {
  font-size: 1.5em;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 0;
  text-align: center;
  transition: color 0.3s ease-out 0s, border-color 0.3s ease-out 0s;
  color: var(--card-block-heading-color);
}
.card-block__image {
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 90%;
  padding: 5px 25px 70%;
  position: absolute;
}
.card-block__body {
  top: 55%;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 2;
}
.card-block__description {
  padding: 0 15px;
  font-size: 1em;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.card-block__full-description {
  opacity: 0;
  padding: 0 15px;
  font-size: 1em;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.card-block a.card-block__overlay-link {
  color: #036;
  text-decoration: none;
  position: absolute;
  border-bottom: none;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  padding: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  transition: color 0.3s ease-out 0s, border-color 0.3s ease-out 0s;
}
.card-block a.card-block__overlay-link:before, .card-block a.card-block__overlay-link:after {
  content: none;
}
.card-block__overlay-bg {
  position: absolute;
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  padding: 0;
  z-index: 1;
}
.card-block__button-more {
  opacity: 0;
}
.card-block:hover .card-block__body {
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(0, -50%);
}
.card-block:hover .card-block__body p {
  -webkit-user-select: none;
     -moz-user-select: none;
      -ms-user-select: none;
          user-select: none;
  color: #fff;
}
.card-block:hover .card-block__title {
  color: #fff;
}
.card-block:hover .card-block__description {
  opacity: 0;
  display: none;
}
.card-block:hover .card-block__full-description {
  opacity: 1;
}
.card-block:hover .card-block__button-more {
  opacity: 1;
}
.card-block:hover .card-block__overlay-bg {
  opacity: 1;
}
